role: The tile entity store and NBT: per-chunk arrays of tile entity pointers (Chunk.chunkTileEntityMap), the block-id to kind map the demand creation uses, constructor defaults per class, and readFromNBT/writeToNBT as canonical NBT text for every kind from chest to end portal.
gpu: line 249, function te_new: calloc of one tile entity per creation (per-entity heap allocation, reachable from block placement in the tick)
line 278, function te_new: malloc of the spawner's mob id string
line 374, function te_put: realloc growth of the per-chunk pointer store
lines 191-195 of tileentity.h used here: the store is an array of pointers to separately allocated entities (pointer graph)
lines 343, 359-368, 389-399: linear scans of the store in creation order; iteration order is the insertion order, not Java's HashMap order
lines 526-852, the render_* functions: build and free an NBT tree and malloc a string per writeToNBT
lines 823-824: global mutable function pointer te_dispenser_random and its context, installed by the machine
lines 104-105, function put_stack: exit(2) on a slot tag that does not parse
notes: The tile entity's tick behaviour (chest lids, hopper cooldown, furnace burn, piston progress) lives in tileticks.c; this file is storage and NBT. te_free does not free te->raw (set by te_set_raw), which looks like a leak; not verified whether the world registry frees it. Furnace readFromNBT does not restore fuel_total (field_145963_i); vanilla recomputes it from the fuel slot, not verified. Java member names for MobSpawnerBaseLogic's fields are taken from the NBT keys and MCP naming, not checked against the Java field list. TileEntityJukebox is a nested class of BlockJukebox.
